obernants.domain: Finite admitted inputs and fixed dependency/schedule state; specialization in operator
obernants.observation_scope: One helper transition or explicitly finite scan trace
obernants.operator: In admitted helper U, candidate inner absent behaviors: nth returning its source, returning a target with fewer than k matching POS words in that direction, cond_sets emitting empty or class-free sets. Loops establish the conditional model; literal directional probes and independent mask families provide finite evidence.
obernants.approximation_semantics: Candidate inner behavior-complement bound, ambiguous preimage, or specialized conditional source relation
obernants.assumptions: Aligned vectors, valid heads, dir in {-1,1}, k in {1,2,3}; cond_sets needs a class atom. nth excludes its source. pending excludes a target whose head lies strictly inside the span except a head equal to the dependent. These are preconditions, not validated input checks.

obernants.operator: For nth returning j, all compatible POS sequences label j with u in direction d, with exactly k-1 u labels strictly between i,j; all other labels/lemmas remain free. None means fewer than k matches before the boundary. cond_sets preserves class and ordered subset members; duplicate atoms can prevent unique recovery. Probe checks directions and mask families.

obernants.operator: For distinct ordered atoms c0..cm, cond_sets emits all subsets containing c0 with up to two tail atoms, preserving their input order. Count=1+m+m*(m-1)/2, not 2^m. Duplicates are positional and may repeat vectors. Probe checks prefix lengths 1..6 against independent bit-mask enumeration and literal counts.

obernants.operator: apply_tr computes all matching non-root moves from initial heads/labels, then mutates ascending word indexes and checks cycles on evolving heads. Matches are not recomputed. Same-head moves can overwrite relations. makes_cycle also returns true on an unrelated existing cycle after its traversal guard expires. Reverse retains overwritten fields and all prestates with compatible snapshotted moves. Cycle helpers executed; full apply_tr is not.
